name: 00_Cerebrum
notes: The vault machinery with no corpus: the operating manual, WHY.md, the OKF v0.2 spec, the knowledge-base template, three skills and 46 scripts. Build 31: the viewer as it stood on 24.10.2026, its last day in the vault. The 3D view's two cinema modes become one, the Timelapse, which plays the vault's years at 180 ms a month, thirteen years in about thirty seconds. Settings opens as a window with About first, What's new, which a vault writes by hand in _scripts/whats-new.json and the template ships empty, and the Brain. The page's renderer escapes the quotes in a link's address, opens only http and https links, and gives the tab a link opens no handle back to the page, with render cases verify.py runs on every commit. vault.py answers from the concepts, read-only, as a command line and as an MCP server; remeasure.py reruns the counts action items carry; closeout.sh runs the five close-out scripts in one command. Question reports open with a management summary and may carry a Key figures table, which verify.py holds to its form. A source's last_modified falls back to an export's created stamp, never to its modified one. viewer-check.js has the checks for all of it, sized to a young vault's months: 204 green on one base, 208 on two. Build 29: bundle.py defines a mirrored website's pages once, the newest version of each with retired addresses left out, and verify.py counts by it; the compile skill describes a reader pass, a second agent that reads each new concept against its cited pages before the commit, because no word list catches a paraphrase firmer than its page; and the knowledge-base template names the German copy of every question report. Build 27: the viewer's week to 08.10.2026. The 3D view has two cinema modes: Film plays the vault's years, each concept appearing at the date of its oldest source, and Flight tours the concepts along the links behind a point of light, at up to sixteen times its pace, with a switch for the camera to follow. Both graphs can be turned: the Option key with a two-finger swipe in every browser, and the two-finger turn itself where the browser gives it to the page. Settings has three tabs, Knowledge bases, Brain and Scheduled tasks, and lists the health checks under a title of their own, On request. The helper offers Claude Haiku 5.5 and one local model, and the launcher starts a new helper when the helper's script has changed. The viewer's address can open the Film. A table in visualize.py, empty here, lets a vault's owner set where the middle of each knowledge base stands. viewer-check.js gained the checks for all of it, and names what it cannot measure in a vault of a few concepts. Build 25: the vault's week to 05.10.2026. One module, bundle.py, now says what a bundle is for every script, and blanklines.py holds the blank-line rules for the audit and its three repairs. verify-cases.py keeps a made-up failing case for each check the audit makes of a knowledge base, and verify.py runs them on every commit. pairs.py lists the contradiction candidates nobody has read since either side changed, changed-pages.py the concepts written before a page they cite was rewritten, and quotes.py the quotations that stand in no page their footnotes cite. The commit hook runs viewer-check.js when a commit changes the viewer. The launcher offers the sign-in from seven days before the login ends. Settings lists a OneNote sync job and the health checks with the scheduled tasks. promote-drafts.py is gone. Build 23: the graph draws every knowledge base round rather than as a line, by raising a stretched group's gravity until its layout is round, and viewer-check.js checks it. Build 21: the viewer's helper offers Claude Sonnet 5.5, and viewer-check.js keeps a running helper out of its Settings geometry checks, which a late answer from it could fail. Build 19 ships the launcher, Open 00_Cerebrum.command, which the viewer already pointed to, and an icon for it drawn from the viewer's mark on a demo vault, so _scripts/set-icon.sh works; build 17 shipped the script without either. Build 17: the concept list groups by knowledge base; Settings shows the Claude app's scheduled tasks; the viewer takes its view and search from its address; a small knowledge base gets a minimum radius on the map; verify.py gains three gauges (content stranded after the footnotes, descriptions behind their sources, source stamps older than the file they cite) and a check of each Raw register; meetings.py reads meeting notes without their transcripts; frozen knowledge bases are left out of the plural runs; and a vault-scoped report can be given a home with VAULT_REPORT_KB. Build 11 brought the 3D view. Unpack it, run python3 _scripts/verify.py, and add a knowledge base from _KB_CLAUDE_TEMPLATE.md.
